what: A blurred background photo panel and a text panel stay stuck to the screen while the section (400vh) scrolls past, and the moment progress passes half, the text group swaps — the current group fades out piece by piece, up 10px, blur 4px and transparent in .8s, while the next group comes into focus in place at the same time, and the background photo also changes in a staggered way in .8s. The side vertical photo group (soft-mask-cycle) uses the same section, with a round mask wiping down. Scrolling back reverses it

options.y: Distance (px) a leaving piece steps aside, default −10 — data-key="still" Pieces (buttons) blur only
options.--fx-height: Section height (CSS variable), default 400vh — about 600vh with three panels
options.--fx-veil · --fx-veil-sp: Blur strength over the background photo (css variable), default 10px · 6px
options.[data-fx-part=bgs]: (if present) background photo panel — inside it [data-fx-part=bg] for as many boards as there are
options.[data-fx-part=deck]: Slot where a stack of posts overlaps in one place
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: A group of posts (two or more)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Pieces that fade within a group (head, title, body, button)
options.[data-fx-part=pics]: (If present) Photo group — data-fx="soft-mask-cycle" Attach auto: off to it as well
